name: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry Ltd.
summary: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry Ltd., formed in 1941 with headquarters in Osaka, Japan, makes and distributes chemical products, including organic reagents, petrochemicals and specialty polymers. Its offerings include acrylic monomers for coatings and adhesives and electronic materials for display devices. It also supplies industrial equipment such as reaction tanks and distillation columns and refines and processes solvents.
